injury_advice.name: Shaedon Sharpe

injury.short: Sharpe suffered a torn meniscus in his knee and is expected to miss six months, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

why: ESPN expects him back 2027-03-02 (about 59 games missed)
about 309 points above a replacement player once he is back

injury_advice.name: Yanic Konan Niederhauser

why: ESPN expects him back 2026-11-01 (about 5 games missed)
about 5 points above a replacement player once he is back

injury_advice.name: Max Strus

injury.short: Strus has been diagnosed with a partially torn plantar fascia in his right foot and he will be re-evaluated in four weeks, Ohm Youngmisuk of ESPN.com reports.

why: ESPN expects him back 2026-11-02 (about 6 games missed)
about 20 points above a replacement player once he is back

injury_advice.name: Jusuf Nurkic

injury.short: Nurkic will miss at least the next four weeks due to a partial plantar plate tear of second toe in right foot, Chris Haynes of NBA TV reports.

why: ESPN expects him back 2026-11-04 (about 7 games missed)
about 451 points above a replacement player once he is back
